era: 2019 MLB.com (the 2018-2019 design seen on the 2019-03 and 2019-07 captures, which are the majority): navy #002d72 header with the white MLB logo on its own row and a second row of small bold uppercase white links (SCORES NEWS VIDEO STANDINGS STATS SCHEDULE PLAYERS MLB.TV TICKETS APPS SHOP AUCTION FANTASY PLAY BALL TEAMS EN), light grey #ececec page with white square cards, condensed 'HEX Franklin' headlines and bulleted headline stacks, dark grey footer with OFFICIAL INFORMATION / HELP/CONTACT US / MORE MLB SITES & AFFILIATES / CAREERS menus. Late 2019 (2019-10/11 captures) moved the logo into a single header row; the two-row header was used for most of the year.
